name: 資料に招待するメンバーの概要
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH15-0013: member invite summary, no full app/device.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for glyph geometry, optical weight, spacing/alignment and fine controls. Use its Invite-people region only, source x0 y860 w1179 h482: heading; ONE current-user avatar and Only-you text; invite button with simple PLUS glyph. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese wording and established type. Replace mock's rough two-person invite glyph with original simple plus. Image3 approved bus style only for white surface/forest-green gradient primary button.
Exact visible Japanese: "メンバーを招待"; current avatar initial "佐"; "自分のみ"; button "招待". No other copy, people or metrics. Heading Meiryo Regular14/24px, helper/self and initial Meiryo Regular12/16px, button Meiryo Regular14/24px, tracking0. Do not use new bold headings.
Compact logical width390px about150px tall with16px insets. Heading left, next row small32px white outlined circular initial佐 followed by自分のみ, then compact44px-tall invite button, plus left of招待. Keep source's simple compact arrangement, preserve ONE member/self state.
White#FFFFFF canvas and rounded white group surface, very subtle neutral outline/soft shadow, no nested decorative cards. Text#1D1D1D, helper#6E6E6E, slate#526173 outline/initial. Primary invite button smooth forest-green gradient#174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white PLUS and legible white label, gentle edge light and restrained shadow.
Accent decision: original orange member circle is identity decoration, adapt to official white outlined avatar; no mint fill. Invite is actual primary action, use green gradient. No random icon colors. Original controls disputed fine details; mock secondary. No share-method panel, source header, Copy-link/Share buttons, extra members/actions, English, IDs, watermarks or annotations. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原図の単純なプラス操作を自作の粗い人物アイコンより優先。原図・自作を開いて照合し生成を目視：メンバーを招待／佐／自分のみ／招待を保持、1人の状態を変更せず、白い細枠の会員表示と緑グラデーション招待。ミントや余計な会員なし。厳密なMeiryoメトリクス・所有者承認・編集性・実装未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
